description: Store all Plaid liability fields during sync for credit cards, mortgages, and student loans. Calculate coverage from depository balances, surface across accounts/dashboard/budget pages, and enrich LLM context.

timing.gatingCondition: Feature 11 (split liability onboarding) ships first so liability accounts are onboarded intentionally.

principles: Coverage base is all depository accounts — checking, savings, money market, CD
Obligations sourced from all liability types — credit cards, mortgages, student loans
Credit card obligation = statement balance; mortgage/loan obligation = next monthly payment
All liability fields nullable — gracefully handle sparse Plaid responses
Coverage data enriches LLM context for smarter financial advice

techStack.database: PostgreSQL with NUMERIC(12,2) and JSONB columns
techStack.testing: node:test integration tests against live database

userStories.title: Store all Plaid liability fields during sync
acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds 8 liability columns to accounts table
Sync stores liability fields for credit cards (liabilities.credit)
Sync stores liability fields for mortgages (liabilities.mortgage)
Sync stores liability fields for student loans (liabilities.student)
All fields nullable — no failures on sparse Plaid responses
userStories.testStrategy: Integration test verifying liability fields persist after sync upsert.

userStories.title: Coverage calculator and API endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/accounts/coverage returns depository_total, obligation_total, ratio, status, obligation breakdown
Obligations include credit cards (type=credit) and loans (type=loan)
Status tiers: clear/healthy/warning/danger based on configurable threshold
Obligations ordered by due date ascending
Credit card obligation falls back to current_balance when no statement balance
userStories.testStrategy: Integration tests for healthy/warning/danger/clear scenarios plus fallback behavior.

userStories.title: Frontend coverage surfaces on 3 pages
acceptanceCriteria: Accounts page: coverage banner with per-obligation breakdown and due dates
Budget: obligations card with total and coverage ratio
Credit and loan account cards show statement/payment balance, due date, minimum payment
userStories.testStrategy: Manual UI verification on all three pages.

userStories.title: LLM context enrichment with liability coverage
acceptanceCriteria: All four context assemblers include liability_coverage block
Financial snapshot includes statement_obligations and coverage_ratio
Liability account objects in query/snapshot contexts include statement_balance and due_date
userStories.testStrategy: Manual verification via Ask Pulse queries about liability coverage.

medium: Plaid may return sparse liability data for some institutions — all fields are nullable to handle this
Mortgage next_monthly_payment may not include escrow at all institutions
low: Coverage calculation assumes statement_balance is the obligation for credit cards — may not match exact payment for zero-balance-transfer accounts

preFlightChecklist: Feature 11 ships first (liability onboarding separated from default flow)
At least one liability account linked via liability-aware onboarding to verify data flows end-to-end
